en fortjeneste.explanation: "En fortjeneste" means "a profit / merit". It comes from the verb "at fortjene" (to deserve). To say a shop makes money, use "give" (to give): "Butikken giver en god fortjeneste" (The shop makes a good profit). When you give someone credit for a good result, it means "merit": "Det er hendes fortjeneste, at vi vandt" (We won thanks to her).

en fortolkning.explanation: "En fortolkning" means "an interpretation". It comes from the verb "at fortolke" (to interpret). To say people understand the same thing in different ways, use the plural: "Der er flere fortolkninger af loven" (There are several interpretations of the law).

en fortsættelse.explanation: "En fortsættelse" means "a continuation". It comes from the verb "at fortsætte" (to continue). At the end of a story told in parts, you read "Fortsættelse følger" (To be continued).

en fortælling.explanation: "En fortælling" means "a story / narrative". It comes from the verb "at fortælle" (to tell). To say what a story is about, use "om" (about): "en fortælling om krigen" (a story about the war). Do not mix it up with "historie" (history), the school subject: "Jeg har historie i dag" (I have history today).

en forudsigelse.explanation: "En forudsigelse" means "a prediction". It comes from the verb "at forudsige" (to predict). To say you predict something, use the verb: "Ingen kan forudsige fremtiden" (No one can predict the future).

en forudsætning.explanation: "En forudsætning" means "a precondition". To say "on the condition that", use "på den forudsætning, at": "Vi kommer på den forudsætning, at det er gratis" (We will come on the condition that it is free). When you talk about what someone brings to a task, use the plural: "Hun har gode forudsætninger for at blive læge" (She has what it takes to become a doctor).

en forvaltning.explanation: "En forvaltning" means "an administration". It comes from the verb "at forvalte" (to manage). To say someone looks after money or property for another person, use "forvaltning af" (management of): "forvaltning af en arv" (management of an inheritance).

en forventning.explanation: "En forventning" means "an expectation". It comes from the verb "at forvente" (to expect). To say something was as good as people hoped, use this phrase: "Filmen levede op til forventningerne" (The film lived up to expectations).

en forværring.explanation: "En forværring" means "a worsening". It comes from the verb "at forværre" (to make worse). To say an illness has got worse, use the verb: "Hans sygdom er blevet forværret" (His illness has got worse).

en forårsdag.explanation: "En forårsdag" means "a spring day". It is built from "forår" (spring) and "dag" (day). To say something happens in spring, use "i foråret" (in the spring): "Blomsterne springer ud i foråret" (The flowers open in the spring).

en forælder.explanation: "En forælder" means "a parent". The plural "forældre" is also part of "et forældremøde" (a parents' meeting at school) and "bedsteforældre" (grandparents): "Der er forældremøde i morgen" (There is a parents' meeting tomorrow).

en fotobog.explanation: "En fotobog" means "a photo book". It is built from "foto" (photo) and "en bog" (a book). To say you made one, use "at lave" (to make): "Jeg har lavet en fotobog fra ferien" (I have made a photo book from the holiday).

en fotograf.explanation: "En fotograf" means "a photographer". It comes from the verb "at fotografere" (to photograph). To show how the two words fit together: "Fotografen fotograferede brudeparret" (The photographer photographed the bride and groom).

en frakke.explanation: "En frakke" means "a coat". To say you hang up your coat, use "at hænge op" (to hang up): "Hæng din frakke i garderoben" (Hang your coat in the cloakroom).

en franskmand.explanation: "En franskmand" means "a Frenchman". It is built from "fransk" (French) and "en mand" (a man). To say where he comes from, use the country, "Frankrig" (France): "Han kommer fra Frankrig" (He comes from France).

en fredagsbar.explanation: "En fredagsbar" means "a Friday bar". It is built from "fredag" (Friday) and "en bar" (a bar). In Denmark, it is a weekly get-together on Friday afternoon at a workplace or a university. To ask someone to come, use "med til" (along to): "Skal du med til fredagsbar?" (Are you coming to Friday bar?)

en fredsaftale.explanation: "En fredsaftale" means "a peace agreement". It is built from "fred" (peace) and "en aftale" (an agreement). To say both sides signed it, use "at underskrive" (to sign): "De to lande underskrev en fredsaftale" (The two countries signed a peace agreement).

en fregne.explanation: "En fregne" means "a freckle". To say someone has freckles, use the plural: "Hun har fregner i ansigtet" (She has freckles on her face). The adjective is "fregnet" (freckled): "en fregnet dreng" (a freckled boy).

en frekvens.explanation: "En frekvens" means "a frequency". To describe a high or low sound or signal, use "høj" (high) or "lav" (low): "en lav frekvens" (a low frequency).

en frelser.explanation: "En frelser" means "a savior". It comes from the verb "at frelse" (to save). In Copenhagen, "Vor Frelsers Kirke" (Church of Our Saviour) is a church with a spiral tower.

en fremgangsmåde.explanation: "En fremgangsmåde" means "a procedure". It is built from "fremgang" (progress) and "en måde" (a way). To say you follow the steps, use "at følge" (to follow): "Følg den rigtige fremgangsmåde" (Follow the correct procedure).

en fremlæggelse.explanation: "En fremlæggelse" means "a presentation (of results)". It is built from the verb "at fremlægge" (to put forward). To say you have one scheduled, use "have" (to have): "Vi har fremlæggelse i morgen" (We have a presentation tomorrow).

en fremmed.explanation: "En fremmed" means "a stranger". To warn a child, say: "Tal ikke med fremmede" (Do not talk to strangers). When "fremmed" describes a noun, it means "foreign": "et fremmed land" (a foreign country).

en fremstilling.explanation: "En fremstilling" means "a production / portrayal". It comes from the verb "at fremstille" (to make). When you talk about making goods, it means "production": "Fremstilling af ost tager tid" (Making cheese takes time). When you talk about how something is shown, it means "portrayal": "Avisens fremstilling af sagen var forkert" (The newspaper's portrayal of the case was wrong).

en fremtid.explanation: "En fremtid" means "a future". It is built from "frem" (forward) and "en tid" (a time). To say something will happen later in life, use "i fremtiden" (in the future): "I fremtiden vil jeg bo i udlandet" (In the future I want to live abroad).
